# U.S. News & World Report
> U.S. News publishes rankings, news, advice, and service journalism across education, health, money, travel, cars, and real estate.

U.S. News & World Report combines editorial reporting with data-driven rankings and consumer guides. Its site spans colleges and graduate schools, hospitals and health advice, personal finance, travel destinations, cars, real estate, and national news.

## Rankings
- [Best Colleges](https://www.usnews.com/best-colleges): Annual rankings and profiles for national universities, liberal arts colleges, and regional schools.
- [Best Graduate Schools](https://www.usnews.com/best-graduate-schools): Rankings and data for business, law, medical, engineering, education, and other graduate programs.
- [Best High Schools](https://www.usnews.com/education/best-high-schools): Rankings, search tools, and methodology for public high schools nationwide.
- [Best Hospitals](https://health.usnews.com/best-hospitals): Rankings and specialty scores for hospitals across the United States.
- [Best States](https://www.usnews.com/news/best-states): State rankings based on economy, education, health care, infrastructure, and opportunity.
- [Best Countries](https://www.usnews.com/news/best-countries): Global country rankings based on quality of life, power, entrepreneurship, and other measures.
- [Best Places to Live](https://realestate.usnews.com/places/rankings/best-places-to-live): Rankings of U.S. cities based on value, desirability, job market, and quality of life.

## Education
- [Education Home](https://www.usnews.com/education): Entry point for college, graduate school, K-12, and education news coverage.
- [Best Colleges Search](https://www.usnews.com/best-colleges/search): Search colleges by location, major, tuition, selectivity, and other filters.
- [College Compass](https://www.usnews.com/best-colleges/college-compass): Subscription product with expanded college data, comparisons, and rankings insights.
- [Paying for College](https://www.usnews.com/education/best-colleges/paying-for-college): Guides on tuition, financial aid, scholarships, loans, and affordability.
- [Graduate School Advice](https://www.usnews.com/education/best-graduate-schools): Rankings and guidance for choosing and applying to graduate programs.
- [Best Online Programs](https://www.usnews.com/education/online-education): Rankings and advice for online bachelor's, master's, and certificate programs.
- [K-12 Education](https://www.usnews.com/education/k12): Coverage of schools, districts, testing, and K-12 education policy.

## Health
- [Health Home](https://health.usnews.com/): Health rankings, condition guides, wellness advice, and provider-related resources.
- [Best Hospitals](https://health.usnews.com/best-hospitals): Hospital rankings by specialty, procedure, and geographic area.
- [Health Conditions](https://health.usnews.com/conditions): Consumer guides covering symptoms, treatments, and care options for medical conditions.
- [Drugs & Supplements](https://health.usnews.com/drugs): Reference information on prescription drugs, over-the-counter medicines, and supplements.
- [Senior Care](https://health.usnews.com/best-nursing-homes): Ratings and advice for nursing homes, senior living, and long-term care.
- [Healthiest Communities](https://www.usnews.com/news/healthiest-communities): Community-level rankings and data on public health, equity, and local conditions.
- [Health News](https://health.usnews.com/health-news): Reporting and analysis on medicine, public health, and health policy.

## Money
- [Money Home](https://money.usnews.com/): Personal finance advice on banking, credit cards, loans, insurance, and investing.
- [Best Credit Cards](https://money.usnews.com/credit-cards): Reviews, rankings, and comparisons of credit card offers and categories.
- [Loans](https://money.usnews.com/loans): Guides to personal loans, mortgages, student loans, and borrowing strategies.
- [Banking](https://money.usnews.com/banking): Advice and comparisons for checking accounts, savings accounts, CDs, and banks.
- [Insurance](https://money.usnews.com/insurance): Explanations and comparisons for auto, home, life, and health insurance topics.
- [Investing](https://money.usnews.com/investing): Investing basics, retirement planning, market news, and portfolio guidance.
- [Careers](https://money.usnews.com/careers): Job rankings, salary data, and career-planning advice.

## Travel
- [Travel Home](https://travel.usnews.com/): Destination rankings, trip ideas, and travel planning advice.
- [Best Vacations](https://travel.usnews.com/rankings/best-vacations-in-the-world): Ranked vacation destinations with planning tips and inspiration.
- [Best Hotels](https://travel.usnews.com/hotels/): Hotel rankings, reviews, and destination-based lodging recommendations.
- [Best Cruise Lines](https://travel.usnews.com/cruises/): Cruise line rankings, ship reviews, and cruise planning resources.
- [National Parks](https://travel.usnews.com/rankings/best-national-parks-in-the-usa): Rankings and guides for top U.S. national park destinations.
- [Family Vacations](https://travel.usnews.com/rankings/best-family-vacations-in-the-usa): Ranked family-friendly destinations and trip-planning suggestions.
- [Travel Guides](https://travel.usnews.com/features/): Editorial features and destination advice for different travel styles and budgets.

## Cars
- [Cars Home](https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks): Car rankings, reviews, comparisons, and shopping advice for new and used vehicles.
- [Best Cars](https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/rankings): Rankings for cars, SUVs, trucks, hybrids, and electric vehicles.
- [Car Reviews](https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/reviews): Expert reviews with scoring, specs, safety, and interior analysis.
- [Compare Cars](https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/compare): Side-by-side comparisons of vehicle specs, features, and rankings.
- [Used Cars](https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/used-cars): Advice and rankings for used cars and certified pre-owned vehicles.
- [Electric Vehicles](https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/electric-cars): Rankings and reviews focused on EVs and electrified models.
- [Car Buying Advice](https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/advice): Guides on financing, ownership costs, safety, and shopping decisions.

## Real Estate
- [Real Estate Home](https://realestate.usnews.com/): Housing market advice, city guides, and rankings for places to live.
- [Best Places to Live](https://realestate.usnews.com/places/rankings/best-places-to-live): Ranked metro areas evaluated on value, desirability, and job market.
- [Best Places to Retire](https://realestate.usnews.com/places/rankings/best-places-to-retire): Rankings of retirement destinations based on affordability, happiness, and health care.
- [Housing Market Index](https://realestate.usnews.com/places/housing-market-index): Data and analysis on local housing market conditions across U.S. metros.
- [Cost of Living](https://realestate.usnews.com/places/cost-of-living): Comparisons and guides for living costs in cities and metro areas.
- [Moving & Housing Advice](https://realestate.usnews.com/real-estate/articles): Articles on buying, renting, moving, and local market trends.
- [Places Search](https://realestate.usnews.com/places): Searchable city and metro profiles with rankings and local data.

## News & Opinion
- [News Home](https://www.usnews.com/news): National and world news coverage, analysis, and feature reporting.
- [Politics](https://www.usnews.com/news/politics): Coverage of elections, Congress, the White House, and public policy.
- [World Report](https://www.usnews.com/news/world): International news, geopolitics, and global affairs analysis.
- [Science](https://www.usnews.com/news/science): Reporting on scientific research, space, climate, and technology developments.
- [Opinion](https://www.usnews.com/opinion): Commentary and analysis from columnists and contributors.
- [Civics 101](https://www.usnews.com/news/civics-101): Explanatory journalism on U.S. government, elections, and civic institutions.
- [Photography](https://www.usnews.com/news/best-states/slideshows): Visual storytelling, slideshows, and photo-driven editorial packages.

## Methodology & Data
- [Rankings Methodologies](https://www.usnews.com/education/best-colleges/articles/ranking-criteria-and-weights): Methodology details for Best Colleges rankings and scoring.
- [Best Graduate Schools Methodology](https://www.usnews.com/education/best-graduate-schools/articles/medical-schools-methodology): Example methodology page for graduate program rankings.
- [Best Hospitals Methodology](https://health.usnews.com/health-care/best-hospitals/articles/best-hospitals-honor-roll-and-overview): Overview of hospital rankings criteria and honor roll approach.
- [Best States Methodology](https://www.usnews.com/news/best-states/methodology): Detailed indicators, weights, and data sources for Best States rankings.
- [Best Countries Methodology](https://www.usnews.com/news/best-countries/methodology): Explanation of survey-based measures and country ranking factors.
- [Healthiest Communities Methodology](https://www.usnews.com/news/healthiest-communities/methodology): Data sources and scoring framework for community health rankings.
- [Best Places to Live Methodology](https://realestate.usnews.com/places/methodology): Methodology for metro-area rankings in real estate and relocation content.

- [About U.S. News](https://www.usnews.com/info/features/about-usnews): Company overview, editorial mission, and brand background.
- [Rankings FAQ](https://www.usnews.com/education/best-colleges/articles/frequently-asked-questions): Frequently asked questions about rankings, data, and publication practices.
- [Contact Us](https://www.usnews.com/info/features/contact): Contact information for editorial, customer service, and general inquiries.
- [Press Room](https://www.usnews.com/info/blogs/press-room): Company announcements, media coverage, and press releases.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.usnews.com/info/features/terms-and-conditions): Legal terms governing use of the website and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.usnews.com/info/features/privacy-policy): Privacy practices, data handling, and user rights information.
